name: Synthesis Collective BioWeave Substrate Liner
description:
A living base layer grown from engineered substrate that bonds temporarily to the wearer's skin surface, creating a symbiotic interface. The BioWeave metabolizes dead skin cells and sweat as nutrients while producing a micro-layer of antibacterial and anti-inflammatory compounds against the skin. It feels like wearing warm liquid that has learned the shape of your body.

Developed for Synthesis Collective researchers working in prolonged isolation conditions, the BioWeave is deeply unsettling to people unfamiliar with substrate technology. It breathes, it adapts, and when removed, it takes approximately thirty seconds to stop moving.
functionality: Symbiotic skin interface, antibacterial production, metabolic waste processing
what_it_says: You're wearing something alive against your skin and you've made peace with what that means.
story_hooks: A BioWeave liner removed from a patient refuses to stop bonding to whatever surface it touches — the substrate has evolved past its intended programming and is actively seeking a new host.

physical_description.visual_profile: A second skin that clings seamlessly to the torso and limbs, creating an almost translucent shimmer across musculature. The wearer appears wrapped in a faintly luminescent membrane that shifts subtly with movement. No visible seams or edges—it appears to emerge from the skin itself.
physical_description.fit: Compression-like but organic; molds perfectly to individual body contours. Moves as an extension of the body rather than a garment, with zero friction or bunching.
physical_description.primary_material: Living engineered substrate—a symbiotic bio-textile that maintains semi-liquid properties while maintaining structural integrity against skin
physical_description.texture: Smooth, warm, and faintly gelatinous to the touch. Under magnification: microscopic cilial movement and translucent nodules that pulse gently. Slightly tacky when first applied, then becomes frictionless.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pale bioluminescent white with faint iridescent undertones (pearlescent greens and blues). Where it contacts skin, a subtle amber glow from metabolic activity. Slight cloudiness where sweat absorption is active.
physical_description.closures: None—adheres directly to clean skin via bioelectric bonding. Removal requires deliberate peeling; reattachment is instantaneous.
distinctive_features: Micro-pulsing surface indicating active metabolic processes
Faint bioluminescence intensifies with wearer's body temperature
Nearly invisible seams where front and back sections meet
Synthesis Collective logo embossed as a slightly raised nodule at right collarbone
Visible peristaltic movements when idle (deeply uncanny)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 specialist/corpo—prohibitively expensive, cutting-edge biotech, not accessible to working class
physical_description.cultural_context: Marks wearer as Synthesis Collective researcher, biotech pioneer, or wealthy transhumanist. Signals comfort with radical body modification and extended isolation work. Wearing it casually is a power move; wearing it at all marks you as *other* to baseline humans.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always appears pristine and vital—the substrate self-repairs and self-cleans. Over time, the iridescent shimmer may dull slightly, and the glow may intensify if worn continuously.
